notes.title: Bleb v 1.2
notes.content:
[p]I'm still working on the game! So I want to show you the new update... 
[b]- you can change the volume of music and sound effects (several people said that this feature is very lacking) 
- the main menu has been changed 
- minor changes to the levels and bug fixes.[/b] [/p][p]
If you find a bug, please report it, so you can [i][b]help me[/b][/i] [i][b]make the game even better![/b][/i][/p]

notes.title: Bleb v 1.1
notes.content:
[i]- changed the inertia of the character, now it is not so strong (levels on which spikes stood next to each other easier to pass)
- fixed problems on some levels
- on level 55 the music is quieter[/i]

I want to say a huge thank you to streamer [b]X - Phantom[/b]!
[i][b]Also the game soundtrack will be released soon, if you like the music in the game, you can buy it in the store![/b][/i]

notes.title: Update after the game's release
notes.content:
Small changes on some levels, as well as fixing minor bugs

Really want to get feedback from every player, in order to improve the games even more!
